# TsugaCollectorConfig

**API:** `observability.tsuga.com/v1alpha1` · **Scope:** Cluster · **Short name:** `tcc`

The name must be `cluster` (enforced by the CRD), so at most one config exists: TsugaMonitoring looks up that exact name, and collector child names are fixed. Secrets must exist in `collectorNamespace`. At least one agent signal must remain enabled. See [runtime defaults](configuration.md) for collector images and resources, which are resolved in code rather than by the CRD.

## Fields

Required is relative to the containing object. Defaults inside optional objects apply only when the containing object exists. Status is read-only. Standard Kubernetes metadata fields are omitted.
